text:
kai: FYI - WellHealth wants to move the eval to a paid pilot. They returned the MSA+DPA with redlines and are pushing Net60 + customer HSM. Need quick alignment on payment structure, POC SLA wording, and who is authorized to sign the order form. tagging @sophie @derek

sophie: Scanned their redlines 1 they removed our scoped audit language and added a customer-managed HSM requirement. For a short pilot we should decline HSM and offer KMS attestation instead. I can put together a concise POC addendum that: scopes audit to an attestation, requires data deletion within 30 days, and explicitly reserves production-only HSM.

derek: Procurement/ops: For trials we avoid Net60 unless credit-approved. Options: 1) 50% prepay + remainder Net45, or 2) Milestone-based invoice (adds billing overhead). Also need Buyer's remit address, PO# and tax id on the PO.

billing-bot: Finance rule: Net60 needs a credit exception. Fast path for pilots is Net45 + 50% prepay. Please provide billing contact + W-9 to billing@redwood.example to speed invoicing.

hana: SE: POC runs on a small dedicated cluster for ~2 weeks, expected load tests may hit bursts. We should avoid committing prod SLOs. Recommend calling it a "POC performance objective" (non-binding) and include an annex with the perf harness. Suggested objective: median latency <150ms under controlled test. I can run a quick benchmark Monday and paste the numbers.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire received: https://redwood-secure/qs/4991 They flagged HSM and data-retention. For POC we can provide KMS attest + scoped logs; customer HSM is not available for temporary trials.

sophie: On signatures: we accept e-sign by an authorized procurement or legal rep. I'll add wording to the order form: "Order Form must be signed by an authorized Buyer representative and include the Buyer PO# if issued." Also adding the 30-day deletion requirement into the POC addendum.

derek: If we take the 50% prepay route, Sales should confirm with the customer whether they can cut a PO to attach to the e-sign envelope. If they prefer milestones, we need to map them to concrete delivery events.

kai: Proposed package to WellHealth: 1) One-page POC addendum limiting audit + 30d deletion; 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45; 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) with perf annex; 4) E-sign allowed from authorized rep + PO attachment. Also offering milestone invoices only if they agree to a small schedule and accept separate invoicing fees. Any objections?

hana: Sounds good. I'll run the perf Monday; if median <150ms we include that as the objective.

sophie: I'll draft the addendum and the order-form clause today and share for rapid review. I'll also remove the mandatory HSM for the POC.

derek: I'll ask the customer to send PO and billing contact to procurement@redwood.example and collect tax info/W-9. If they insist on Net60 escalate for credit exception.

kai: Action items recap: @sophie draft addendum + order-form language; @hana perf run Monday; @derek collect PO/remit/W-9; finance to approve Net45+50% prepay; I'll assemble e-sign envelope and route. :thumbsup:

kai: Quick snippet to include in the order form/email:
```
Term: Pilot / POC (approx. 2 weeks)
Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 from invoice date (Net60 requires credit approval)
SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding)  target median latency 150ms under controlled perf test
Data: Customer data to be deleted within 30 days after pilot completion
```

kai: If there are no objections to the prepay ask or the non-binding language I'll send this to the customer and route for e-sign.
